items.name: dictation-input
items.title: Dictation Input
items.description: A normal text input or textarea with a microphone in its corner (visually concentric corners): record with Voice Glow along the field or a level/dots effect inside it (each with its own processing motion), mic picker, transcript written into the same field, recap player, reset with confirm, and a send/don't-send-recordings line inside the field. Glow by Voice Glow (Jakub Antalik, MIT).
items.docs: Dictation Input wraps a text field: wrap your own Input or Textarea in <DictationInput>. Wire onTranscribe to your server and honour sendRecording=false (transcribe, never store). Glow: Voice Glow by Jakub Antalik (https://libraries.dev/voice), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Jakub Antalik. Guide: https://github.com/Launch-Studio-Labs/launchstudio-labs/blob/main/skills/dictation-input/SKILL.md

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: Image Cropper
items.description: Crop, straighten, turn and flip a photo without ever showing an empty corner: the photo scales and clamps itself to always cover the crop frame. Drag handles, aspect presets, a straighten dial, pinch, two-finger rotate, trackpad pinch and keyboard. Optional AI fill: go past the edges and a pluggable generateFill (an image model behind your server) fills the empty parts. Exports to Blob or canvas at full resolution.
items.docs: Give <ImageCropper> a src and a ref; call ref.current.toBlob() to export. For AI fill, pass generateFill and post the image and mask to a server route that calls your image model (key on the server only). Guide: https://github.com/Launch-Studio-Labs/launchstudio-labs/blob/main/skills/image-cropper/SKILL.md
